statement: Pinned SDL2 release 2.30.12 requires successful factory SPI stick calibration, vibration-enable subcommand and input-report-mode subcommand before completing direct HIDAPI Joy-Con opening. Pinned SDL3 does not make the latter two write return values fatal in its corresponding open caller.

applicability.revision: SDL2 release-2.30.12 at 8236e01; SDL3 at 535d80b; Linux v5.16 df0cc57 and later 4056b3c; joycond 0df025a; HHD 4184f03; all source-only
applicability.scope: Direct HIDAPI branch of SDL2 and SDL3 only, not evdev or a host experiment.
